info.title: DenebLab StashLock CLI
info.description: Command-line interface for StashLock secrets management vault. Uses X25519 ECIES envelope encryption with AES-256-GCM for keypair-based secrets management.

commands.name: cstring
commands.description: Generate a StashLock connection string from a vault directory.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Tag to build the connection string for [Default: @""]

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key for box.tag (falls back to STASHLOCK_API_KEY env var) [Default: @""]

options.name: --base64
options.description: Print only the base64-encoded connection string

options.name: --env
options.description: Print only the environment variable assignment
